body:
on this day in 2010: a leak forced taylor to release her single almost two weeks early -- and it worked anyway.

"mine," the lead single off speak now, was announced by livestream and set for august 16. then an unauthorized mp3 hit the internet in early august. she's admitted the leak made her cry. big machine's answer was to just... ship it early -- rushing "mine" to country radio and itunes on august 4, twelve days ahead of schedule.

the scramble paid off. "mine" raced up itunes on day one and debuted at no. 3 on the hot 100 with 297,000 downloads -- at the time the eighth-biggest sales debut ever for a digital song. it introduced speak now two and a half months before the album arrived.

sometimes the plan falls apart and the thing works out better than the plan.
